themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Astera Labs announced Aries 7 on Oct 8, the first PCIe 7 signal conditioning family for both copper and optical links, with samples to select hyperscale and OEM customers in Q4 2026. It is a 2027 and later revenue story, but it keeps Astera ahead of Marvell and Credo as rack to rack links move to optics.

themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: The rare earth deadline moved. The US China truce, which keeps China's October 2025 rare earth rules suspended, now runs to January 10, 2027 instead of November 10, 2026, per Bessent (Sep 23) and China's commerce ministry (Sep 28). Western producers get two more months without a supply shock, but the ministry statement does not name rare earths, so watch for a formal notice.

themes.name: Healthcare and Medtech: Aging, Heart, Sugar, Hearing, Sight
themes.what: Medtronic set the MiniMed split-off ratio at the 4.5939 cap on Oct 7, and the swap of up to 225.4 million MiniMed shares closed for tenders on Oct 9. Medtronic retires about 49 to 55 million of its own shares and gives up most or all of its MiniMed stake, so MiniMed gets a much larger float that new holders may sell.

innovations.name: Healthcare
innovations.what: FDA accepted Intellia's lonvo-z filing with priority review and set a March 10, 2027 decision date, with no advisory panel planned. The first in vivo CRISPR approval now has a date, and chronic HAE drug makers have a clock on them.
